data.title: Trival Valderas vs Leganes Tips - Spanish Cup
data.content:
Last weekend, Leganes were beaten by Albacete 3-1 in front of the home crowd and slipped down to 17th place, just a couple of points above the relegation zone.

## Team News

The home side have no reported injuries or suspensions ahead of this clash.

Leganes will be without striker Alex Millan who is struggling with fitness. Veteran Alvaro Morata is their top striker this season with three goals but might start on bench here.

## Verdict [...] Leganes are tipped to score in both halves in their fixture against Trival Valderas. This recommendation is supported by Leganes' recent attacking output, having created and missed many chances in their last two league matches, resulting in a combined expected goals (xG) of 5.10 and four goals scored. The fact that Trival Valderas are a semi-professional side further strengthens the case for Leganes to find the net in both halves.
